paragraphs: R. Neḥemyah HaAmsuni—some say R. Shimon HaAmsuni (see his entry)—expounded every et in the Torah. On reaching 'The Lord your God you shall fear,' he withdrew, until R. Akiva came and expounded it to include Torah scholars, Kol Sha'ah 22b; Kiddushin 57b [digital text: 57a]; Bava Kamma 41b; Bekhorot 6.
